name: Pension Sonnenhof
beschreibung:
The Sonnenhof is located in the centre of Walchsee in the Tyrolean Kaiserwinkl, with views of the lake and the Kaisergebirge. The family-run Sonnenhof of the Kaltschmid family at Dorfstraße 1 offers holiday apartments and studios, all with a kitchen and free Wi-Fi; some units have a balcony with lake view.

The cross-country ski trail starts right in front of the house, and the stop for the free ski and hiking bus in the Kaiserwinkl is at the building. Guests enjoy free admission to the leisure and wellness facilities of the holiday club by the lake, about 350 metres away, with indoor pool, outdoor pool and sauna. The bathing lake of Walchsee is within a few minutes' walk, and the lifts on the Zahmer Kaiser are about 2.5 kilometres away. Check-in is from 3 pm, check-out until 10 am; there is a charging station for electric cars on the private car park.
